room_selection: First three ascending HouseID with one AC, non-inverter split, tonnage/setpoint/phase present, complete minute current and monotonic unique indoor timestamps; no selection by model fit
room_area_basis: paper average bedroom area; individual bedroom area not recorded; dwelling area not substituted
proxy_energy: max(primary-phase current - median OFF current on development dates, 0) x AC-status x 230V x PF0.9; household-phase incremental proxy, NOT AC submeter ground truth

limited_tuning.selection: one shared pair for all selected rooms; development mean(CV_RMSE_fraction + operating_temperature_RMSE/2C); no evaluation output used to select
limited_tuning.cop: 3.4 unchanged reference; star rating not converted to measured COP

cu_scope: 2019 Floor2, all 16 AC channels, no building-total claims
cu_quality: all 1440 minute samples finite nonnegative across all AC channels; weekday only; incomplete days excluded, never filled zero
cu_normalization: hourly energy divided by same day's mean hourly energy, then average across common complete weekdays
cu_sensitivity: OLS daily energy on daily mean outdoor temperature divided by mean daily energy; measured and model use same accepted dates
madrid_selection: Centros administrativos; same EDIFICIO must have one unambiguous general active kWh meter, exactly one finite nonnegative record per month; one gas kWh/m3 meter with valid January/February/December measurements and positive winter use; missing gas summer values retained as missing, not zero; renamed/ambiguous/submeter scopes excluded
eligibility_amendment: Before Madrid model or seasonal outcomes were computed, initial complete-12-month gas requirement yielded zero eligible buildings because summer gas records are missing. Gas is only an eligibility indicator, not used for energy comparison; amended to observed winter gas use. Initial selection and failed run preserved in attempts/0a47319.
gas_boundary: gas metering alone does not establish predominant gas heating or absence of electric heating
monthly_proxy: positive part of monthly electricity minus fixed transition-month mean, retained for all 12 months; winter excess NOT automatically cooling
correlation: 12 monthly signed electricity-minus-baseline values vs same-year CDD18; Pearson per building
model_office: unchanged RoomSpec defaults; one room, one equipment, weekdays 08-18, 60-min precooling; no scaling to buildings
